# HOOOP

> HOOOP is a sustainable marketing and strategy collective helping climate and circular businesses bridge the gap between innovation and adoption.

HOOOP works at the intersection of sustainability, circular economy, marketing science, digital transformation and behavioural change. We combine brand and marketing strategy, market intelligence, commercial partnerships and behavioural insight to help businesses grow credibly and at scale.

## Website

- [Homepage](https://www.hooop.in): Overview of HOOOP, its mission and capabilities.

## Mission

Building brands and businesses through marketing-led interventions that make sustainable choices commercially viable.

## Practices

- Marketing-led consulting: brand and narrative strategy, sustainability communication audits, audience discovery, claim substantiation.
- Media sustainability: ESG media planning, green media buying, campaign carbon measurement, media intelligence.
- Policy, advocacy and stakeholder engagement: PR and communications, environmental law and policy advisory, circular economy policy.
- Market access: commercial partnerships and cross-border expansion across India, the UK and EU.

## Expertise

- Sustainable Marketing
- Brand Strategy
- Circular Economy
- Greenwashing
- ESG Media
- Behaviour Change
- Ocean Plastics
- Marine Circularity
- Blue Economy
- Marketing Science

## Core Pages

- [Offerings](https://www.hooop.in/offerings): Marketing-led consulting, media sustainability, policy and market access.
- [Sense](https://www.hooop.in/sense): Free greenwashing checker for sustainability claims.
- [Greenwashing](https://www.hooop.in/greenwashing): Greenwashing risk, Indian regulation and a practical playbook.
- [ESG Media Index](https://www.hooop.in/esg-media-index): India's first ESG Media Index, built with The GoodNet.
- [Prvaah](https://www.hooop.in/prvaah): India, UK and EU market entry programme.
- [Research](https://www.hooop.in/research): Original research, reports and insights.
- [Thinking](https://www.hooop.in/thinking): Articles and thought leadership.
- [Manifesto](https://www.hooop.in/manifesto): HOOOP's philosophy and principles.
- [Contact](https://www.hooop.in/contact): Contact information and enquiries.
